# Sysinternals MCP -- LLM corpus

> Version 0.1.0. FastMCP 3.4 wrapper for 12 Sysinternals CLI tools.
> First-run auto-downloads binaries from live.sysinternals.com; no EXEs committed to git.

Generated: 2026-07-04

---

## Architecture

```
src/sysinternals_mcp/
  server.py       -- FastMCP app, tool registration, dual transport (stdio/HTTP)
  bin_manager.py  -- download, Authenticode verify, cache, EULA management
  tools/
    autoruns.py   -- autorunsc: startup/persistence CSV parser
    handle.py     -- handle64: open handle parser
    pslist.py     -- pslist: fixed-width process table
    listdlls.py   -- listdlls: multi-section DLL listing
    tcpvcon.py    -- tcpvcon: TCP/UDP connection CSV parser
    sigcheck.py   -- sigcheck: Authenticode CSV parser
    accesschk.py  -- accesschk: effective permissions text parser
    psloggedon.py -- psloggedon: logged-on user table parser
    psfile.py     -- psfile: remote open-file text parser
    coreinfo.py   -- coreinfo: CPU topology label parser
    du.py         -- du: directory size line parser
    psinfo.py     -- psinfo: system info section parser
```

### Binary lifecycle

1. On first `run()` call, `BinaryManager.ensure()` checks cache at
   `%LOCALAPPDATA%/sysinternals-mcp/bin/`
2. If missing, downloads from `https://live.sysinternals.com/<name>.exe`
3. Verifies Authenticode: rejects anything not signed by Microsoft / Sysinternals
4. EULA accepted once per machine (marker file in cache dir)
5. Subsequent calls use cached binary directly

### Output parsing

| Tool | CLI flag | Parser |
|------|----------|--------|
| autorunsc | `-c` | `csv.DictReader` |
| handle64 | `-v` | Regex: pid:name type handle |
| pslist | (default) | Fixed-width column split |
| listdlls | (default) | Multi-section regex |
| tcpvcon | `-c` | `csv.DictReader` |
| sigcheck | `-c` | `csv.DictReader` |
| accesschk | (default) | Regex: access-level path |
| psloggedon | (default) | Fixed-width table |
| psfile | (default) | Path: header + details |
| coreinfo | (default) | Label: value + feature flags |
| du | `-v` | Regex: bytes path |
| psinfo | (default) | Section: key: value |

### Tool signatures

```python
autorunsc(accept_eula, hashes, verify, all_users) -> dict
autorunsc_schedule(accept_eula, hashes) -> dict
handle64(pattern, verbose) -> dict
handle64_by_pid(pid) -> dict
pslist(include_kernel, tree) -> dict
pslist_detail(name) -> dict
listdlls(verified) -> dict
listdlls_by_pid(pid) -> dict
tcpvcon(all_states) -> dict
sigcheck(path, recursive, virus_total, accept_eula) -> dict
accesschk(path, target, recursive, accept_eula) -> dict
accesschk_service(service_name) -> dict
psloggedon(local, network) -> dict
psloggedon_server(server) -> dict
psfile(path_filter, accept_eula) -> dict
psfile_close(file_id) -> dict
coreinfo(all_features) -> dict
du(path, n_children, accept_eula) -> dict
du_quick(path) -> dict
psinfo(show_hotfixes, show_services) -> dict
psinfo_remote(server) -> dict
```

### Standard return schema

```json
{"success": bool, "error": str | null, ...tool-specific fields...}
```
